# List of awards and nominations received by Park Bo-gum

}}
South Korean actor and singer Park Bo-gum () is known for his versatile performances and has been recognized with several awards and nominations across film, television, theater, and entertainment including two Grand Prizes (Daesang),), which translates to "Grand Prize", is the highest honor given out at South Korean award ceremonies.}} two Baeksang Arts Awards, a Blue Dragon Series Award, an Asian Academy Creative Award, a Seoul International Drama Award, and a Korea Broadcasting Prize. In addition, he is a two-time Gallup Korea's Television Actor of the Year (2016, 2025) and the first actor to ever top Forbes Korea Power Celebrity list (2017).
Park has also been accorded by his home country with several state honors including a Prime Minister's Commendation in 2022 for his active involvement in coal briquette charity, orphanage volunteer work, and comfort women support events – working to further expand his positive influence as a public figure.
